# Security

Only the latest commit on `main` receives security fixes.

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/GTStagg/eyas-mcp/security/advisories/new) (the repository's **Security** tab, then **Report a vulnerability**), not in a public issue. Never include API credentials, tenant data or customer data in a report.

Vulnerabilities in dependencies should also be reported to their own maintainers.
